shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,105p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && rg -n -C 3 'DashKit|Charts|Navigation' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc "for p in dashkit charts navigation icons; do node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/"'$p/package.json'"').version\"; done
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg '(INDEX.md|types.d.ts|AsideHeader.d.ts|Chart.d.ts|index.css|styles.css)"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | head -65
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | head -65
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -180
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components | rg '/(Button|Select|Modal|DropdownMenu|TextInput|Text)/.*d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && rg -o '\"(Layout["'^" ]*|Chart[''^" ]*|Arrow[''^" ]*|Gear|Bell|Plus|Calendar|Grip|Magnifier|Ellipsis|Persons|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|Sliders|Xmark|Chevron[''^" ]*|Globe|Database|Square[''^" ]*|ArrowDownToLine|Clock|Envelope|Target|CirclePlay|Bars)[''^"]*"'"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '/(Button|Select|Modal|DropdownMenu|TextInput)/.*d.ts"'$'"' | head -25
sed -n '1,135p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md
sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/pie.md
sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/area.md
rg -n -C 3 'CSS|--gn|--g-aside|render|width|background|Logo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -120
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm | rg '(DashKit.d.ts|settings|plugins.*d.ts|types.*d.ts)' | head -25
python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re
s=urllib.request.urlopen('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').read().decode()
open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html','w').write(s)
names=set(re.findall(r'\"componentName\":\"(["'^"]+)"'"',s))
print(sorted(names)[:150])
print(s[:300])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'const s=await(await fetch(\"https://gravity-ui.com/icons\")).text(); console.log([...new Set(s.match(/(?:Layout|Chart|Arrow|Gear|Bell|Plus|Calendar|Grip|Magnifier|Ellipsis|Persons|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|Sliders|Xmark|Chevron|Globe|Database|Square|Clock|Envelope|Target|Bars)[A-Za-z]*/g))].slice(0,180).join(\"\\n\"))'
sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/plugin.d.ts
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/common.d.ts
rg -n -A 80 'CSS API' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -125
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -95
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | head -95"

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'export.*(Layout|Chart|ArrowUpRight|ArrowDownTo|Gear|Bell|Plus|Calendar|Grip|Magnifier|Ellipsis|Persons|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|Sliders|Xmark|Chevron|Globe|Database|Clock|Envelope|Target|Bars|Heart|Copy|TrashBin|Square)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.d.ts | head -65
rg -n -A 70 'interface (Settings|Plugin|PluginWidgetProps)|type (Settings|Plugin)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/*.d.ts
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/line/types.d.ts | head -95
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/pie/types.d.ts | head -100
rg -n -A 100 'interface ChartData|type ChartData|interface Chart' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/chart/types.d.ts | head -125
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -100
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -75
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/colors.md | head -100
cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -8
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -20
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | rg '(TextInput.*d.ts|Select/types.d.ts)"'$'"'
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/types.d.ts | head -80
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/settings.js | head -80
rg -n 'cols:|rowHeight:|containerPadding:|margin:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm -g '*.js' | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Layout|Chart|Arrow|Gear|Bell|Plus|Calendar|Grip|Magnifier|Ellipsis|Persons|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|Sliders|Xmark|Chevron|Globe|Database|Clock|Envelope|Target|Bars|Copy|TrashBin|Square)[A-Za-z]*.d.ts"'$'"' | head -70
rg -n 'interface (ChartData|LineSeries|AreaSeries|ChartAxis|PieSeries)|type (ChartData|LineSeries|PieSeries)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -25
rg -n 'width|--gn-aside' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/variables.css | head -15
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -75
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/react-grid-layout.d.ts | head -90
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/chart-ui.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '35,135p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts
sed -n '40,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts
sed -n '35,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/area.d.ts
sed -n '30,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/pie.d.ts
rg -n -C 2 'interface ChartXAxis|interface ChartYAxis|grid:|grid\\?|labels\\?|ticks\\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(ChartLine|ChartColumn|ArrowUpRight|ArrowDownRight|ArrowDownToLine|ArrowRight|Bell|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Clock|CircleQuestion|CircleCheck|Gear|Ellipsis|Envelope|Database|Copy|ArrowRotateLeft).d.ts"'$'"'
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/index.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'numberFormat|formatter|format\\?' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -45
rg -n -C 2 'draggableHandleClassName|noOverlay' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head -55
rg -n -C 2 'color\\(|parseColor|opacity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color.js | head -55
cat index.html
rg -n 'peerDependencies' -A 10 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json
rg -n -C 2 'filter|group|menuGroups' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\"; let s=fs.readFileSync(\"src/App.tsx\",\"utf8\"); s=s.replaceAll(\"chart: {margin: 0}\",\"chart: {margin: {top:0,right:0,bottom:0,left:0}}\").replace(\"labels: {numberFormat: {suffix: '\"'\"' тыс.'\"'\"'}}, \",\"\"); fs.writeFileSync(\"src/App.tsx\",s);'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'draggableHandleClassName' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/ReactGridLayout.js
rg -n -C 3 'isMobile' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridItem.js
rg -n 'enabled|visible' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | tail -12
rg -n 'base-float|base-background' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridItem.css | head -10
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'draggableHandle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/Layout.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/context/*.js
rg -n -C 2 'getComputedStyle|var\\(|resolveColor|parseColor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/utils/color.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color.js
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color.js | head -45
rg -n 'lineWidth|fillOpacity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/plugins/area -g '*.js' | head -10
rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm | rg '(variables|AsideHeader.css|PageLayout.css)'"
